name: Daniyal
msgs: My mother gave me your number. I'm sorry in advance.
My mother gave me yours. So we're both victims.
Thank God. I was ready to apologise for forty years.
Out of habit. Can I ask one real question?
Is it about my salary or my cooking?
Neither. What have you never told an aunty?
That I want someone to read my poems before they read my rishta file.
closer: Before the file, before the family, there is a person who wants to be read.
